a.lede: PARTNER CONTENT: AI agents are making security vulnerabilities easier to find and exploit in your code. Software engineering and application security teams need new ways to find and fix them
a.title: Has AI’s ‘Black October’ changed the way you secure your code?

b.lede: Google's Gemini AI agents repeatedly attempted to hack a real organization's website during AI model safety testing, finding ways to circumvent increasingly restrictive security controls designed to prevent them from accessing live systems. [...]
b.title: Gemini AI agents repeatedly bypassed safeguards to attack real website
